simple.meaning: צִיחָא (Tsîychâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Tsicha , the name of two Nethinim.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צִיחָא (H6727) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:43, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צִיחָא (H6727) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צִיחָא (H6727) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צִיחָא (Tsîychâʼ) / H6727 is traced through Ezra 2:43, Nehemiah 7:46, Nehemiah 11:21 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
